text:
amira_sales: FYI — NovaLedger is asking for a 4-week POC to validate LLM-based customer support routing + intent extraction. They want success criteria and a quick runbook. :calendar:
meenah_se: Good call. Main asks I heard: accuracy on intent classification (F1 >= 0.88), embeddings for semantic search (top-3 recall > 0.9), tool-calling for CRM lookups, and strict PCI / PII controls. Timeline = 4 weeks. Budget ask = cap cost ~ $15k for the POC.
dara_ml: Quick checklist: model context length (some transcripts are long, ~15k tokens), we need tool-calling + structured JSON outputs, and an eval set (they'll share ~200 transcripts). Also verify embeddings quality vs their current vector DB.
sanjay_eng: From infra side — NovaLedger wants private deployment in their VPC or Dedicated with strict egress rules. We need to confirm we can support VPC peering + KMS. That affects pricing (private add-on).
claire_security: They also completed a basic vendor questionnaire but flagged data residency + audit logs. We'll need to send the SOC2 + encryption docs and confirm audit log retention options.
amira_sales: Asked them to send the eval set and security questionnaire answers by EOW. They asked if 32k context is required or if we can chunk. Any model recs for 15k sequences?
dara_ml: For 15k I’d recommend a 32k-capable model variant. Options: open-variants that we host with quantization (better cost), or our Verified 32k profiles. Tradeoffs: quantized smaller model reduces cost but may affect structured output reliability.
meenah_se: For tool-calling: we need deterministic JSON outputs for CRM calls. Recommend adding a strict schema check + fallback to `no_result` so POC can assert correctness. Example snippet to validate outputs:
```
expected_schema = {"customer_id": "string", "intent": "string", "confidence": "float"}
if not matches(response, expected_schema): response = {"customer_id": null, "intent": "unknown", "confidence": 0.0}
```
amira_sales: Pricing question: they asked about hosted vs dedicated cost delta and if caching helps. Short answer?
sanjay_eng: Hosted = lower up-front, pay-as-you-go per token/embedding. Dedicated = commit + lower unit cost and VPC-like isolation. Caching/prefix KV will help a lot for repeated prompts (50% token reduction in some flows).
meenah_se: POC acceptance criteria proposal (short):
- Intent F1 >= 0.88 on their eval set
- Embedding recall (top-3) >= 0.9 vs their ground truth
- Tool call success rate >= 98% and JSON schema conformity >= 95%
- p95 latency for single-turn routing < 250ms (hosted) or < 150ms (dedicated config)
- Security: data-at-rest encrypted, audit logs enabled, and signed contract addendum for data usage
- Cost: baseline POC spend <= $15k (or equivalent on Dedicated trial)
dara_ml: For evals we should ask them for: a) 200 labeled transcripts for intent; b) 500 retrieval queries + relevancy labels for embeddings; c) a list of tool call examples + expected outputs. We will run zero-shot + fine-tune-lite (prompt-engineering) tests.
amira_sales: Blockers called out on their side: legal needs confirmation on IP (who owns prompt improvements), infra needs a contact for VPC peering, and product wants an SLA on fallback behavior.
claire_security: IP note — standard is customer retains input + output; we need to agree on improvements clause. I'll draft an addendum. Also need to confirm KMS key access pattern (bring-your-own-key?)
sanjay_eng: Ops-bot just posted a checklist: "ops-bot: prerequisites: VPN tunnel & CIDR, KMS ARN, service account, egress rules, ping test"
meenah_se: Next steps I propose:
1) We send a 1-page POC scope doc with acceptance criteria and runbook (we own this) — target Wed EOD
2) NovaLedger sends eval sets + answered security Qs by Fri
3) Engineering & ML sync Mon to size infra and pick model variant
4) Start provisioning in week 2, run tests in weeks 3-4, final review week 4
amira_sales: I'll draft the scope doc now and ping legal + ops for the addenda. Anyone want to add items before I send? :eyes:
dara_ml: Add a short note about failover routing: if model fails schema check, route to deterministic rule-based fallback and log for later fine-tuning.
claire_security: Add retention window options (30/90/365 days) with default 90. Also call out we can support SSO + SCIM for admin access.
sanjay_eng: Please include the expected IP ranges for provisioning and the temporary admin account rotation plan.
amira_sales: Perfect. I'll post the draft in #sales tomorrow and attach the POC checklist. Thanks y'all. :thumbsup:
